Team —

We pulled an orphaned-opps export for Acme (attached). There are ~27 opportunities where the close date is more than 90 days old and the stage hasn't moved in >60 days. Finance flagged several of these as inflating our committed funnel for the 2027Q3 forecast.

As discussed in the ops hygiene policy, please action the following by EOD Friday:

- Owners: confirm whether each opp is still active or archive (reason required).
- If active but uncertain: move to "Commit Review" and add a one-line win criteria and expected next step.
- If the customer has gone dark: tag as "orphan — rotate" and add the last contact date.

Attached: orphan-opps-export-20270719.csv (has lead owner column & last_activity). Also added a short rotation-playbook-v1.pdf with suggested cadence for rotating unclaimed opps.

For Acme specifically, Elaine — I looped procurement to confirm there are no internal freeze/PO issues that would block close date movement. If you can confirm any POs or timeline changes, let us know and we will snap the opps out of the rotation.

My ask: owners update SF by Friday COB and add a Triage note on each record (reason + next step). I will take a sweep on Monday and rotate remaining orphans to the queue for reassignment.

Thanks — quick wins here help the forecast accuracy for the week.

Dylan Brooks
